commit-format.label: Conventional Commits
commit-format.description: Commit subjects follow type(scope): subject, e.g. feat(api): add retry.

commit-format.label: Imperative short subject
commit-format.description: A short imperative subject with no type prefix, e.g. Add retry to the client.

branching.label: Trunk-based
branching.description: Short-lived branches off the default branch, merged back quickly.

branching.label: GitHub Flow
branching.description: One feature branch per change, named feature/<slug>, merged through review.

branching.label: Git Flow
branching.description: Long-lived develop plus feature/, release/ and hotfix/ branches.

naming.label: kebab-case files, camelCase identifiers
naming.description: File names are kebab-case and variables and functions are camelCase.

naming.label: snake_case throughout
naming.description: File names and identifiers are all snake_case.

naming.label: PascalCase types, camelCase values
naming.description: Types and classes are PascalCase and variables and functions are camelCase.

code-comments.label: Comment the why, not the what
code-comments.description: Comments explain intent and constraints, not what the code plainly does.

code-comments.label: Doc-comments on public API
code-comments.description: Every public function, type and module carries a doc-comment.

code-comments.label: Minimal comments
code-comments.description: Prefer self-explanatory code and comment only the non-obvious.

formatting-linting.label: Formatter and linter enforced
formatting-linting.description: A formatter and linter are run by command; the commands shown are placeholders you must replace with your own.

formatting-linting.label: .editorconfig only
formatting-linting.description: Whitespace and encoding are governed by an .editorconfig file, with no enforced formatter.

formatting-linting.label: None enforced
formatting-linting.description: No standing formatting or linting requirement.

testing.label: Tests for every change
testing.description: Every code change ships with a test that covers it.

testing.label: Tests for bug fixes and public behaviour
testing.description: Bug fixes and public behaviour need a test; internal refactors do not.

testing.label: No standing expectation
testing.description: Testing is decided case by case.

file-layout.label: src/ plus tests/
file-layout.description: Source lives under src/ and tests under tests/ at the top level.

file-layout.label: Co-located tests
file-layout.description: Each test file sits next to the module it covers.

file-layout.label: Flat top-level modules
file-layout.description: Modules live directly at the top level without a src/ wrapper.

language-tooling.label: Pinned runtime and committed lockfile
language-tooling.description: The runtime version is pinned and the dependency lockfile is committed.

language-tooling.label: Latest stable, no pinning
language-tooling.description: Use the latest stable runtime and dependencies without pinning.

documentation-placement.label: Published docs in docs/
documentation-placement.description: Content for readers goes in docs/ and internal notes are kept elsewhere.

documentation-placement.label: Everything in docs/
documentation-placement.description: All documentation, public and internal, lives in docs/.

documentation-placement.label: README only
documentation-placement.description: Documentation lives in the README with no docs directory.
